item.title: 8th Annual Raspberry Jam Tech Extravaganza returns to University of Charleston on March 14
item.description: Tech lovers, get ready! The 8th Annual Raspberry Jam WV is coming back to the University of Charleston on Saturday, March 14, for a full day of hands-on innovation in Charleston. The in-person event will feature interactive workshops, live tech talks, and plenty of opportunities to build, code, and experiment with Raspberry Pi projects. #KanawhaCounty #WOAY

item.title: Kanawha County Sheriffs seeking community’s help in searching for runaway teen
item.description: Kanawha County Sheriffs are seeking the public's help in locating a runaway teen. Authorities are searching for 14-year-old Joseph Lawrence. Officers report Lawrence was last seen on Monday, March 2, at approximately 10:30 a.m. in the Eskdale area riding a lime green bicycle #KanwhaCounty #WOAY

item.title: Harrison County native Reese Allen announced as 2026-2027 West Virginia University Mountaineer
item.description: Allen is a dual major in mechanical engineering and data science and says becoming the Mountaineer is his way of giving back to the University he calls home. He’s a member of the WVU Benjamin M. Statler College of Engineering and Mineral Resources, part of the Honors College, and has served as a Presidential Student Ambassador.

item.title: Suspect extradited to Raleigh County from Ohio in connection with shooting investigation
item.description: Raleigh County Sheriffs have extradited a suspect to the Mountain State in connection with a shooting investigation Authorities report that on Monday, March 2, Detective Dunlap and Deputy White extradited 41-year-old Joseph Shelton to West Virginia from Cleveland, Ohio. #RaleighCounty #WOAY
